turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Sisaqhubeka nokufunda. Njengamanje sesingena kwi-module yesibili emayelana nenqubekela phambili yokufunda ngokwamabanga ahlukene.
turns.en: We are still continuing with learning. Right now we are entering the second module about the progression of reading according to different grades.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Le module ibalulekile ngoba inika umhlahlandlela ngenqubo yokuthuthuka kancane kancane ekufundeni kuze kufinyelele esimweni esingcono.
turns.en: This module is important because it gives a guide about the process of progressing little by little in reading until reaching a better state.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Emva kokuqeda umsebenzi wale module, uzokwazi ukuqonda
turns.en: After finishing the work of this module, you will be able to understand

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: umsebenzi wale module uzokwazi ukuqonda inqubekela phambili yengqikithi kanye nokuqukethwe kwebanga ngalinye kusukela kokulula kuya kokunzima.
turns.en: the work of this module you will be able to understand the progression of the theme and the content of each grade from the easy to the difficult.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Kule module uzofunda futhi ngezigaba eziyisithupha zokuthuthukisa ukufunda.
turns.en: In this module you will also learn about the six stages of developing reading.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Ngithanda ukusebenzisa ulwazi lwami lwenqubekela phambili yokufunda nezigaba eziyisithupha ukubona izimpawu ngasinye ukuze ngifundise kangcono abafundi bami.
turns.en: I would like to use my knowledge of reading progression and the six stages to see the signs of each so that I can teach my learners better.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Engingithanda sikuqaphele kakhulu ukubona amakhono okufunda
turns.en: What I would like us to pay close attention to is to see reading skills

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: kufanele sikuqaphele kakhulu ukubona amakhono okufunda kuqala namakhono ebangeni lokuqala kuya kwelesithathu.
turns.en: we must pay close attention to see reading skills first and skills in grade one to three.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Sesingaqala manje sifunde kabanzi ngenqubekela phambili yokufunda ngokwamabanga ahlukene.
turns.en: We can start now and learn more about the progression of reading according to different grades.
